glance.h2: What a 1-Bed vs. a 2-Bed Actually Costs
glance.lede: Nearly every sale at The Lakes is a 1- or 2-bedroom. Here's what each sold for over the last 5 years.
glance.ratio: One- and two-bedrooms sell about equally often here, so there are recent comps for either size — unusual for a community this size.

life.lead: Built by Baldwin Homes in 1984–1985, The Lakes is set around five small lakes connected by streams, with koi and lily ponds, grassy walkways and four decades of mature trees. It's one of the most affordable ways into a 92130 address, with no Mello-Roos. See the full The Lakes community profile.
reasons: Lakes, streams and koi ponds run through the grounds, and many units look out on them.
Piazza Carmel is about 5 minutes on foot, and the elementary and middle schools are within half a mile.
Older construction means no special tax on top of the property tax — a real monthly saving next to newer communities.

hoa.intro: One monthly fee covers the grounds, the water features and the amenities.
hoa.fee_note: 2025 sales listed $560–$565; every 2026 listing shows $599, so expect about $599 now. Confirm the current fee for a specific unit.
hoa.also: landscaping, exterior building maintenance and common-area upkeep. Units have in-unit laundry, and there is EV charging and guest parking.
hoa.compare_note: The Lakes' HOA is on the high side for nearby condos, but there's no Mello-Roos, which narrows the gap with newer communities. Ranges are from 2025–2026 MLS listings.

faq.q: What is the price range for The Lakes condos?
faq.a: Over the last 5 years, The Lakes condos sold between about $550,000 and $935,000: 1-bedrooms $550K–$815K (median $644K) and 2-bedrooms $659K–$935K (median $805K).

faq.q: What are the HOA fees at The Lakes?
faq.a: MLS listings show $560–$599 per month: 2025 sales listed $560–$565, and every 2026 listing shows $599. The fee covers the pool, spa, tennis and pickleball courts, the lakes and koi ponds, landscaping, exterior maintenance and the community room. Confirm the current fee for a specific unit.
No. None of the recent MLS listings at The Lakes show a Mello-Roos assessment, and the property tax rate is about 1.07% of assessed value.

faq.q: How big are the units at The Lakes?
faq.a: From about 791 sq ft (1-bedroom) to 1,269 sq ft (2-bedroom). Most 1-bedrooms are 790–950 sq ft and most 2-bedrooms are 1,100–1,270 sq ft.

faq.q: What is parking like at The Lakes?
faq.a: Each unit has a reserved covered carport space with extra storage, plus guest parking and EV charging stations. There are no garages.

faq.q: How quickly do The Lakes condos sell?
faq.a: About 8 homes a year have sold here over the last 5 years. The median time on market was about 12 days, so well-priced units go quickly.

faq.q: How does The Lakes compare to other Carmel Valley condo communities?
faq.a: The Lakes and neighboring Arborlake are the two Carmel Valley condo communities built around water. The Lakes is a few years older, sells at similar prices, has a higher HOA ($560–$599 vs. $450–$460) and carport parking. Carmel Pointe is newer with garage parking and a lower HOA.
